pov: 第一人称（Four 视角）· 现在时

facts.event: Zeke 收枪后一把从 Four 手里拿走咖啡杯，道谢并抱怨墙外供应的东西是“garbage water”。
facts.text: Zeke holsters his gun and grabs the coffee cup right out of my hands. “Bless you, Four. The stuff they have out here is garbage water.”

facts.event: Zeke 说今天要做全盘点，因为有人把武器交付数点错，等于整整一箱（an entire crate）枪不见了。
facts.receivers: the weapons deliveries, an entire crate full of guns
facts.text: “The monotony wears on some people,” Zeke says. “Case in point, later today we have to do a full inventory because some idiot miscounted the weapons deliveries. We’re missing an entire crate full of guns is what that means. How do you miscount an entire crate?”

facts.event: 分队时 Eric 先挑 Peter、Edward、Drew、Molly 与 Al；Four 与 Lauren 这队除 Uriah 外得 Lynn、Will、Marlene，因有两个队长而少一人。
facts.receivers: Peter, Edward, Drew, Molly, Al, Uriah, Lynn, Will, Marlene
facts.text: Eric takes Peter, then Edward, Drew, Molly, and Al. In addition to Uriah we get Lynn, Will, and Marlene. We’re short a player because we have two captains.

facts.event: Tris 指着旗帜说必须再往上，它缠在头顶约 fifty feet 的金属支架上，而梯子已到尽头。
facts.receivers: the banner, the metal support, the ladder
facts.text: “I have to go higher than this,” she says, pointing up at the banner. It’s wrapped around a metal support maybe fifty feet above us. And there’s no more ladder to take us up there.

facts.event: 一阵风让 Tris 失衡时，Four 本能伸手扣住她的髋部、拇指勾住腰带环，随即把她推回平衡。
facts.receivers: her (Tris’s) hip, belt loop, jacket hem
facts.text: I reach for her by instinct, my hand closing around her hip. My thumb hooks under one of her belt loops; my first two fingers press into the soft skin just beneath the hem of her jacket. For a second my breath catches, and I stare at my hand on her, suddenly aware of how warm she is.

facts.event: Four 觉得 Tris 与初见时不同：她看得太多，正把他埋了两年的 Tobias Eaton 一点点挖出来。
facts.text: She looks different to me now than she did then. Eyes wide and bright and almost glowing in the moonlight. I told her she didn’t know me, and that was a lie. She knows too much, sees too much.

facts.event: 两人在轮上远望，只见市中心方向一大股黑烟，像黑云从天而降吞掉一角。
facts.receivers: the city, a huge plume of dark smoke
facts.text: She’s staring at the city. Our view is obstructed by the big black building at the end of the pier, but I see what she’s looking at anyway: there’s a huge plume of dark smoke in the distance.

facts.event: Tris 厉声说必须下去，因为 Christina、Mae 和父亲都在 Candor 总部，而这场火“很可能是——”（指 Evelyn）。
facts.receivers: Christina, Mae, my father, the fire
facts.text: “I have to get down,” she snaps at me. “Christina is at Candor headquarters, and Mae, and my father, and the fire, it was probably—”

relations: Four（Tobias Eaton）与 Tris 在摩天轮下重逢：Tris 因安全屋被袭而怀疑他告密，Four 否认并承诺没告诉任何人，Tris 最终说“I believe you”。
Four 由“她只是 Evelyn 的跑腿”转为主动伸手护住 Tris、并坦白自己害怕，关系从对峙转向信任。
Tris 为取 Fox 旗帜独攀摩天轮，Christina 因怕撞上 Peter 而先撤往 Candor；Four 抛下夺旗赛跟上去当 spotter。
四与 Evelyn 的母子关系通过“Evelyn 可能是纵火者”的猜疑被再次拉紧：Four 说他不信任 Evelyn，但也不想伤害她。
numbers: an entire crate — 丢失的是“an entire crate full of guns”（整整一箱枪）
one a week — 信号中继器巡检分段，“tackle only one a week”（每周一段）
two captains — 因“we have two captains”而少一名队员
fifty feet — 旗帜在头顶“maybe fifty feet above us”
two hundred feet / one hundred and fifty feet — 轮顶两百英尺，Tris 估旗帜在一百五十英尺处
